definitions.short: to tie , physically ( gird , confine , compact ) or mentally (in love , league )
definitions.usage: bind (up), (make a) conspire(-acy, -ator), join together, knit, stronger, work (treason).
definitions.full: H7194. qashar קָשַׁר verb bind, league together, conspire (Late Hebrew id., bind, join , קֶשֶׁר knot ; קְטַר ᵑ7 , Syriac bind ( ט for ת after ק ) Nö ZMG xi.735 , who compare also ('perhaps') Arabic force to do a thing, Ethiopic bind ); — Qal Perfect 3masculine singular קָשַׁר Amos 7:10 ; 1Kin 16:16 ; 2 masculine singular suffix וּקְשַׁרְתָּם consecutive Deut 6:8 , etc.; Imperfect 3masculine singular וַיִּקְשֹׁר 1Kin 15:27 +, וַיִּקְשָׁרֿ 2Kin 15:30 , etc.; Imperative masculine singular suffix קָשְׁרֵם Prov 3:3 +; Participle active plural קשְׁרִים 2Sam 15:31 +; passive feminine singular קְשׁוּרָה Gen 44:30 ; Prov 22:15 ; plural קְשֻׁרִים Gen 30:42 ; — 1 bind: a. literal, with accusative of thing + עַל Gen 38:28 (J), Jer 51:63 , + ב , Josh 2:18 , 21 (JE); bind, confine , with accusative רֵים Job 39:10 (+ בְּתֶלֶם ), accusative of crocodile Job 40:29. b. figurative, with accusative + עַל Deut 6:8 ; 11:18 ; Prov 3:3 ; 6:21 ; 7:3 (all of religious and moral precepts); with בְנַפְשׁוֺ קְשׁוּרָה נַפְשׁוֺ ב, Gen 44:30 his life is bound up with his [namely the boy's] life (J; of strong affection); ק ׳אִוֶּלֶת בְלֶבנָֿ֑עַר Prov 22:15 . c. passive participle vigorous (properly well- knit ; opposed to עֲטֻפִים ) Gen 30:42 (J). 2 league together, conspire: with עָ person against 1Sam 22:8 ; 22:13 ; Amos 7:10 ; 1Kin 15:27 ; 16:9 ; 2Kin 10:9 ; 15:10 ; 15:25 , 21:23 ; 21:24 2Chr 33:24-25 , 24:21 ; with accusative of congnate meaning with verb קֶשֶׁר , 1Kin 16:20 ; 2Kin 12:21 ; 15:15 , + עַל person 14:19 2Chr 25:27 ; 2Kin 15:30 ; absolute 1Kin 16:16 ; Neh 4:2 (+ infinitive purpose); with עִם , together with, 2Sam 15:31 . Niph`al Perfect 3feminine singular נִקְשְׁרָה 1Sam 18:1 the life of Jonathan was bound up with the life of David ( Qal 1 b ); Imperfect 3feminine singular כָּלהַֿחוֺמָה וַתִּקָּשֵׁר Nehemiah 3:38 all the wall was joined together (the circuit complete). Pi`el Imperfect 1 bind on (as ornament), 2 feminine singular suffix וּתְקַשְּׁרִים Isa 49:18 (figurative; || תִּלְבְּשִׁי ). 2 bind fast , 2 masculine singular תְקַשּׁר ( הַ ) כִּימָה מַעֲדַנּוֺת Job 38:31 canst thou bind fast the bands of the Pleiades ? Pu`al Participle הַמְּקֻשָּׁרוֺת הַצּאִן Gen 30:41 (J), = Qal 1 with Hithpa`el conspire: Perfect 3plural עַלֿ הִתְקַשְּׁרוּ 2Chr 24:25 (|| 2Kin 12:21 Qal 2 ); Imperfect 3masculine singular אֶלֿ וַיִּתְקַשּׁר 9:14 ; Participle plural עָלָיו הַמִּתְקַשְּׁרִים 2Chr 24:26 .
